_comment: Tier-2: MappingApplication.MapperFactory is deprecated — it moved to KratosMultiphysics core in Kratos 10.x. Pitfall (kratos._auxiliary_overview #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Both attributes resolve, so nothing breaks; the observable fact is that they are two DISTINCT objects (MAP.MapperFactory is not KM.MapperFactory), which is what a deprecation shim looks like. New code should dot MapperFactory off core. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
